audience.text: Python developers building applications that process PDF documents, including batch workflows, document validation, text extraction, and conversion to other formats.

capabilities.text: Create pages of arbitrary size, draw paths with full stroke state, add text with Unicode and font substitution, and place stamps, images, tables, and lists.
capabilities.title: Create and edit PDF content

capabilities.text: Extract text, words, tables, and annotations; convert to HTML, Markdown, SVG, TIFF, PNG, or WebP; export attachments and images as ZIP.
capabilities.title: Extract and convert content

capabilities.text: Validate internal links, bookmarks, form fields, and conformance to PDF/A, PDF/UA, PDF/X; sanitize metadata, scripts, attachments, and hidden layers.
capabilities.title: Validate and sanitize documents

capabilities.text: Apply password or certificate-based encryption, sign with PAdES-LTA, generate visible signature appearances, and manage permissions.
capabilities.title: Secure and sign documents

capabilities.text: Substitute fonts for non-embedded ones, embed fonts for PDF/A compliance, and render pages with full glyph outlines, shadings, and blend modes.
capabilities.title: Manage fonts and rendering

capabilities.text: Add, read, edit, and export annotations of many subtypes; create, fill, flatten, and validate AcroForm fields.
capabilities.title: Work with annotations and forms

capabilities.text: Compare page views or extracted text between versions; optimize resources, deduplicate images, and subset fonts.
capabilities.title: Compare and optimize documents

capabilities.text: Bound input size, object counts, decoded-stream bytes, and image pixels when loading untrusted PDFs to prevent hangs or crashes.
capabilities.title: Apply resource limits for untrusted input

limitations.text: Page rendering is a best-effort rasterizer, not a certification-grade visual engine: overprint support is a composite RGB preview and complete PDF 2.0 imaging semantics are not implemented.
PDF/A and PDF/UA validation are heuristic checks against document structure, not certification-grade validation; use a dedicated validator such as veraPDF for formal compliance.
OCR and layout reflow are not implemented; text replacement and redaction rewrite matched runs in place but never reflow the surrounding layout.
SVG export writes polylines rather than curves and text as glyph outlines, which renders exactly but is not selectable; blend modes and transparency groups are not expressed.
Public-key encryption covers RSA recipients only; key-agreement, password, and KEK recipient types, and RC2-encrypted envelopes, are rejected explicitly.
WOFF2 decoding and complex-text shaping each need an optional extra; without them these paths fall back to file-name metadata or fail explicitly.

problems_solved.text: Extract text, words, tables, and annotations from PDFs for reporting, indexing, or data processing.
Convert PDFs to HTML, Markdown, SVG, TIFF, PNG, or WebP for web publishing, review, or archival.
Validate PDF structure, internal links, form fields, and conformance to PDF/A, PDF/UA, or PDF/X standards.
Secure documents with password or certificate-based encryption, digital signatures, and sanitization.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Python is an open-source, MIT-licensed Python library for creating, reading, editing, rendering, and validating PDF documents, targeting Python 3.11+.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported annotation subtypes for import via import_annotations_json is not explicitly listed in the facts.
Whether the bundled JPEG 2000 decoder supports all ISO 15444-1 parts beyond packed packet headers and progression order changes is not detailed.
The behavior of Document.compare_text when one document has a text layer and the other does not is not specified.
Whether font substitution affects text extraction or editing (not just rendering) is not clarified beyond rendering-only statements.
The exact set of resources excluded from export_images_zip (e.g., inline images, annotation appearances) is stated, but inclusion of nested Form resources is ambiguous.
Whether Document.validate_links checks for cycles in action chains is not explicitly confirmed.
The exact set of fields and limits covered by PdfLoadLimits beyond max_input_bytes, max_decoded_stream_bytes, and max_image_pixels is not fully enumerated.
Whether the low-code plugins support streaming inputs/outputs beyond FileDataSource and ByteArrayDataSource is not detailed.

workflows.name: Load and inspect a PDF
workflows.text: Open a PDF with Document, inspect page count, version, info, fonts, and embedded files.

workflows.name: Extract and export content
workflows.text: Extract tables as CSV, text with clipping, or annotations as JSON for downstream processing.

workflows.name: Render pages to images
workflows.text: Rasterize pages to PNG, TIFF, or WebP with configurable DPI, clipping, and background.

workflows.name: Split and merge documents
workflows.text: Split by blank pages, bookmarks, or text markers; merge or interleave pages from multiple files.

workflows.name: Compare documents visually or textually
workflows.text: Compare page views or extracted text between versions, with optional difference images.

workflows.text: Use Merger, Splitter, Optimizer, Converter, Rotator, Stamper, and FormFlattener with DataSource interfaces.
